messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED - Elevated KV cache paging + continuous-batching regression in prod (us-east-1). Spike of 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate. Suspected paged KV block-manager thrash after recent block_size tuning rollout. Kickoff thread for live mitigation and customer-impact assessment. Runbook: <https://intra.redwood/runbooks/paged-kv-thrash>

maya: noticing batch-window spikes from ~20ms -> ~120ms for some clients, causing batch sizes to balloon and KV working set to blow up. eviction-rate x10, kv_cache_size_ratio ~0.92 on several instances. Putting quick logs below for context:

maya: ```
[2026-03-15T19:02:11Z] blockmgr: alloc_block id=0x7f3f size=64MB used=63MB
[2026-03-15T19:02:12Z] blockmgr: evict block id=0x6c1f reason=thrash
[2026-03-15T19:02:13Z] batching: window_ms=120 observed_batch_tokens=9876
[2026-03-15T19:02:13Z] kvcache: eviction_rate=102/s metadata_nodes=4031
```

ben: i'm oncall. immediate mitigation plan: 1) tighten continuous-batching window to 10ms 2) reduce batch_max_tokens 2048 -> 1024 3) disable background block compaction on canary. will push via runtime config rollout to canary first. executing now.

ben: rollout command:
```bash
# reduce batching window and max tokens
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/batching/window_ms","value":10},{"op":"replace","path":"/batching/max_tokens","value":1024}]'
# disable compaction on canary
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/paged_kv/compaction/enabled","value":false}]' --context=canary
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config/runtime/paged-kv-hotfix-1912345678 -> runtime-canary. link: <https://deploys.redwood/internal/1912345678> :rocket:

anya: after canary patch: eviction-rate dropped ~65% on canary nodes, tail latency down ~30% for these hosts. however seeing repeated warnings in block-manager about metadata references: `block_meta_unlinked` across a few blocks. snippet:

anya: ```
[2026-03-15T19:07:01Z] blockmgr WARN block_meta_unlinked id=0x5b2a refs=0 orphaned=false
[2026-03-15T19:07:05Z] blockmgr WARN block_meta_unlinked id=0x5b2a refs=0 orphaned=true
```

maya: i suspect the metadata leak/false-orphaning started when block_size auto-rollout changed small-block allocation heuristics yesterday. compaction may be racing with eviction under heavy write patterns. proposal: keep compaction disabled for now and promote batching window change cluster-wide if canary holds for 30m.

ben: applying compaction=false to canary confirmed. will hold 15m before promoting to 10% traffic. if metrics stay stable, graduate to 30% then 100%. watchlist: eviction_rate, kv_cache_size_ratio, tail latency p99.9, 5xx rate.

deploy-bot: Patch applied: paged_kv.compaction.enabled=false on runtime-canary at 2026-03-15T19:09:12Z.

csd-ekaterina: CS note: we received two customer tickets (CustA, CustB) about timeouts around 19:01-19:05. Both retried from SDKs and recovered. Current visible impact: ~0.6% of requests returned 5xx in the 4-minute spike window. No major data loss reported. I'm preparing a short status for customers and will update if errors reoccur.

maya: monitoring: canary eviction-rate -> baseline down to 0.8x, tail latency p99 down ~30%. overall error rate dropped back to baseline. still seeing the `block_meta_unlinked` warnings but no obvious request failures tied to that yet.

ben: next actions: - keep compaction disabled cluster-wide if stable after 30m - open post-incident ticket to revert auto-rollout of block_size heuristics and investigate metadata leak traces - add additional telemetry for block-meta lifecycle and refcounts

anya: taking handoff in 40m. My plan: keep canary for 45m, graduate to 30% if eviction_rate < 2x baseline and p99 latency stable. if eviction_rate > 2x baseline at any point I'll roll back batching window to 50ms and re-enable compaction to default in a controlled rollback.

ben: noted. i'll create the ticket now and tag infra/allocator-team.

ben: ticket created: INFRA-2489 - Investigate block_size auto-rollout and paged-kv metadata leak. linking runbook and config diffs.

maya: quick sanity checks for oncall: commands to query metrics: 
```bash
# eviction rate (last 5m)
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?query=kv_eviction_rate%5B5m%5D&env=prod" | jq .
# block meta warnings in logs (last 1h)
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=1h | grep block_meta_unlinked | tail -n 30
```

csd-ekaterina: will post a customer-facing blurb if we stay stable for the next 30m. tagging @support on escalation path.

anya: grabbing the handoff. I'll run periodic checks and update every 15m. If anything regresses i'll escalate immediately. 

maya: recording incident owner: @anya. timeline so far: 19:02 detected -> 19:04 batching window & max_tokens tighten applied -> 19:09 compaction disabled on canary -> 19:15 canary metrics improved.

ben: thumbs: :thumbsup: Good job everyone. Ensure we get a root-cause postmortem and a follow-up remediation (disable auto-rollout or gate it behind canary)

oncall-bot: Handoff complete. Incident owner: anya. Please update thread with any new developments. Archive when resolved.
